# StorezFix

> Professional digital setup services for USA businesses. Fast delivery. Guaranteed results. PayPal protected.

StorezFix is a productized digital services company serving small and medium businesses across the United States. Every service is delivered by a 43-person in-house expert team with 13+ years of experience. All services are one-time payment, no monthly retainers, no contracts, and backed by a 100% money back guarantee with PayPal Buyer Protection on every order.

## Services

### Shopify Speed Optimization
- URL: https://storezfix.com/shopify-speed.html
- Pricing: $97 Audit (24-hour delivery) | $497 Full Fix (48-hour delivery)
- Guarantee: 90+ Google Desktop PageSpeed score and 65+ Mobile score — or full refund
- Includes: Image compression, WebP conversion, CSS/JS minification, lazy loading, font optimization, app bloat removal, caching setup, render-blocking fixes, Core Web Vitals optimization, before/after report, video walkthrough, 30-day support
- Best for: Shopify store owners with slow loading stores, low PageSpeed scores, poor Core Web Vitals
